name: Sylvanas Windrunner
summary: In the Undercity, Sylvanas Windrunner rules the Forsaken from beneath Lordaeron's ruins. Once Silvermoon's Ranger-General, she was slain and raised by Arthas Menethil, then broke free of the Lich King's control. She joined Thrall's Horde to help secure her people's future and seeks vengeance on the Scourge.

sections.title: Fall of the Ranger-General
sections.body: Sylvanas Windrunner once commanded Quel'Thalas's defense as Silvermoon's Ranger-General. When Prince Arthas Menethil led the Scourge into the high elven kingdom to reach the Sunwell, she fought to hold him back. Angered by her resistance, Arthas murdered her and denied her a clean death. He tore her soul from her body and made her a vengeful banshee, forcing her to serve the Scourge and help slaughter her own people.

sections.title: Rise of the Forsaken
sections.body: After the Third War, the Lich King's weakening grip let Sylvanas break free and reclaim her preserved body. She gathered other undead who had regained their free will, then drove the dreadlords from Lordaeron's ruins. She named her people the Forsaken and made the Undercity their realm beneath the ruins. Isolated and threatened by Scourge remnants, zealous Scarlet crusaders, and wary human realms, the Forsaken needed allies. Sylvanas made an uneasy alliance with Warchief Thrall and the Horde.

faq.answer: Sylvanas Windrunner rules the Forsaken from the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. Once Quel'Thalas's elven Ranger-General, she was slain and raised by Arthas Menethil, then broke free of the Scourge and took command of the free-willed undead.

faq.q: Why did Sylvanas align the Forsaken with the Horde?
faq.answer: Sylvanas allied the Forsaken with the Horde because the living nations of the Alliance revile them as monsters. With the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade threatening them in Lordaeron, she sought strong allies for her people's survival and petitioned Warchief Thrall to join the Horde.

faq.q: How did Sylvanas break free from the Lich King?
faq.answer: Sylvanas broke free when the Lich King's psychic power began to fade after the Third War, fracturing his control over the Scourge. Among the first powerful spirits to regain autonomy, she reclaimed her mortal remains and turned her wrath on Arthas.

Sylvanas seeks retribution against Arthas Menethil and the Scourge for destroying her homeland and enslaving her soul. She also works to fortify the Undercity and secure a lasting haven for the Forsaken in Lordaeron.

angles.text: To the Forsaken, Sylvanas is a liberator and protector. They credit her with giving them free will and a fortified home instead of leaving them to serve the Scourge mindlessly.
Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and Thrall's compassion helped bring Sylvanas into the Horde, but many orcs and trolls remain wary of her and her court.
